name: Freezing Ward Trap
body:
Freezing Ward Trap
CR 2

XP 600

Type magical; Perception DC 26; Disable Device DC 26

EFFECTS

Trigger touch; Reset none

Effect Atk +5 melee touch. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 cold damage and is restrained as chains of ice manifest around his arms and legs. The chains are as impressively strong and require a DC 19 Escape Artist check to break out of or must be shattered (20 hp, 4 hardness).
